description: This file declares the interface 'DoubleArray' which provides a standard contract for implementations managing expandable arrays of double values. It includes method signatures for array size, element access and modification, bulk addition, rolling addition, and clearing the array.

methods.name: getNumElements
methods.description: Returns the number of elements currently stored in the array, which may differ from internal storage length.

methods.name: getElement
methods.description: Retrieves the element at a specified index, throwing an exception if out of bounds.

methods.name: setElement
methods.description: Sets the value at a specified index; expands the internal storage if necessary.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Adds a new element to the end of the array.

methods.name: addElements
methods.description: Adds multiple elements to the end of the array from a provided array.

methods.name: addElementRolling
methods.description: Adds an element to the end, removing the first element, effectively acting as a rolling buffer, and returns the discarded value.

methods.name: getElements
methods.description: Returns a copy of the internal array elements.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the array, removing all stored elements.
